## Site Overview

This is the personal website and portfolio of Chris Taylor, a Network Operations Chief with 30 years of experience in infrastructure automation, network operations, and systems integration.

**Owner**: Chris Taylor
**Location**: Salt Lake City, UT, USA
**Email**: ctaylor@christaylor.codes
**GitHub**: https://github.com/christaylorcodes
**Website**: https://christaylor.codes

## Site Purpose

Professional portfolio and blog showcasing automation expertise, PowerShell development, network operations knowledge, and open source contributions to the MSP (Managed Services Provider) community.

## Key Areas of Expertise

- Infrastructure Automation
- Network Operations & Architecture
- PowerShell Scripting & Module Development

- ConnectWise Platform (Manage, Automate, Control)
- Multi-cloud environments (Azure, AWS, GCP)

## Notable Open Source Projects

- **ConnectWiseManageAPI**: PowerShell wrapper for ConnectWise Manage REST API (118 stars, 69 forks)
- **ConnectWiseControlAPI**: PowerShell wrapper for ConnectWise Control (81 stars, 38 forks)
- **ConnectWiseAutomateAgent**: PowerShell module for CW Automate (13 stars)
- **Initialize-PSGallery**: PowerShell Gallery initialization tool (21 stars)

All projects published to PowerShell Gallery under MIT license.

## Key Terminology

**MSP**: Managed Services Provider - company providing IT services to clients
**PSA**: Professional Services Automation - software like ConnectWise Manage
**RMM**: Remote Monitoring and Management - software like ConnectWise Automate
**ConnectWise**: Suite of MSP tools (Manage, Automate, Control, RMM)
**PowerShell Gallery**: Official repository for PowerShell modules (PSGallery)
